features.name: total_juv_offenses
features.description: Sum of all juvenile offenses including felonies, misdemeanors, and other charges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of juvenile criminal history, which is useful for establishing linear margins.

features.name: priors_per_year_adult
features.description: Rate of prior offenses per year of adulthood (age minus 17).
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes prior counts by exposure time, creating a smooth rate feature that linear models can weight effectively.

features.name: log_priors_count
features.description: Log-transformed count of prior offenses to compress the long tail.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in prior counts, improving the stability of the linear SVM decision boundary.

features.name: age_severity_interaction
features.description: Interaction between youthfulness (years under 50) and the log of prior offenses.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly provides the linear model with a non-linear interaction term combining age risk and criminal history.

features.name: recent_criminal_activity_score
features.description: Assess the recency and intensity of criminal activity based on days_b_screening_arrest, c_days_from_compas, and priors_count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures semantic nuances of how recent arrests and screenings correlate with ongoing risk, providing a continuous severity score.

features.name: is_young_with_priors
features.description: Indicator for individuals under 25 who already have at least one prior offense.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a sharp linear projection for a specific high-risk demographic subgroup.

features.name: weighted_criminal_history
features.description: Weighted composite of criminal history, assigning higher weights to felonies and adult priors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-computes a domain-informed severity score, allowing the SVM to use a single strong continuous feature for criminal past.

features.name: days_b_screening_arrest_abs_log
features.description: Log-transformed absolute days between screening and arrest.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the wide variance in screening-to-arrest times into a smooth, normalized scale suitable for linear models.

features.name: c_days_from_compas_log
features.description: Log-transformed days from COMPAS assessment to current charge.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness in the temporal gap feature, preventing large values from dominating the SVM margin.

features.name: charge_severity_judgment
features.description: Evaluate the severity of the current charge based on c_charge_degree and its context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical charge degrees into a continuous, ordinal severity measure that a linear model can easily weight.

features.name: risk_score_composite
features.description: A composite risk assessment based on decile_score.1, score_text, v_decile_score, and v_score_text.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple baseline categorical risk assessments into a single continuous probability-like score.

features.name: priors_to_age_ratio
features.description: Ratio of prior offenses to total age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an alternative normalized rate of offending that scales smoothly across the entire age range.
